title: Wiemer dot field (v2)
description: A backdrop of large pale dots on a square grid, like a perforated plate, with content centred on top. Dots darken under the pointer and fade back slowly, leaving a soft trail.
notes: dots show from lg up; phones get the content alone
best on a muted band: dots use the secondary colour
name: wiemer-v2-dot-field

props.name: children
props.description: what sits centred over the dots (a form card, say)

props.name: rows
props.description: rows of dots (default 9); with the columns this sets the field's height
